categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as a commercial bank offering a wide range of financial services including deposit and remittance services, wealth management, credit lending, electronic banking, foreign exchange, trust services, investment services, gold passbook services, and insurance agency services. It serves both individual consumers and corporate clients, with a focus on consumer finance and corporate finance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The bank employs advanced digital technologies such as robotic process automation (RPA), online loan application platforms, mobile banking apps, and integrates big data analytics and AI to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency. It also maintains robust information security systems certified with ISO 27001 and ISO 22301 standards, and implements multi-layered cybersecurity defenses including firewalls, intrusion detection, and data leakage prevention.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The bank serves a diverse customer base including individual consumers, small and medium enterprises (SMEs), and corporate clients. It focuses on local industries in the Kaohsiung region and broader Taiwan market, providing financial products tailored to support local economic development, green finance, and sustainable investment initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: The bank operates primarily within Taiwan, with 40 branches concentrated mainly in Kaohsiung City (25 branches), and additional branches in New Taipei City, Taipei, Taichung, Tainan, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, and Pingtung. It does not have overseas branches or listings.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly engaging with end customers by providing banking, trust, investment, and insurance agency services. It acts as a financial intermediary facilitating capital flow and financial transactions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating digital transformation, enhancing fintech innovation, and strengthening data analytics capabilities to improve service efficiency and risk management. The bank emphasizes sustainable finance, green finance products, ESG risk assessment integration, and compliance with evolving regulatory frameworks. It also invests in employee training and talent development to support these initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through interest income from lending activities, fee income from wealth management and financial services, investment income, and commissions from insurance agency operations. The bank also earns income from foreign exchange and electronic banking services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The bank positions itself as a regional bank with strong local ties in Kaohsiung, differentiating through its focus on sustainable finance and digital innovation. It faces competition from other Taiwanese banks, including larger financial holding groups and emerging pure digital banks, but leverages its local government shareholder support and community integration as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the end of 2023, the bank reported total assets of approximately NT$350.7 billion, a 14.27% increase from the previous year. Net profit before tax was NT$1.315 billion, up 9.13%, with net profit after tax of NT$961 million, an 11.10% increase. The bank completed a NT$5 billion cash capital increase in 2023, enhancing capital adequacy and supporting business growth. Loan and deposit balances also grew significantly, reflecting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The bank emphasizes its commitment to sustainable and responsible banking, offering green and ESG-linked financial products such as green deposits and sustainable loans. It differentiates through strong local presence in Kaohsiung, personalized customer service, integration of digital technologies for convenience and security, and active corporate social responsibility initiatives. Its governance and risk management frameworks further enhance trust and reliability.
